name: benefitdial
description: BenefitDial — an independent, ad-supported public utility that helps Medicare beneficiaries compare their plan year-over-year and project their Social Security COLA. No phone numbers, no lead-gen, no data sales.

scripts.build: node scripts/legal-build.mjs --check-only && node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/legal-build.mjs --out dist
scripts.build:data: node scripts/build-cola-data.mjs && node scripts/build-medicare-figures.mjs && node scripts/build-aep-data.mjs && node scripts/build-plan-data.mjs
